fixed.item: Adoption breakage (adopt_status.json breakages, cleaning; round-5 identity finding): members of the spray_bottle look-alike group carried no liquid amount, so manipulation's shake and heft told cleaning's sprays from mechanisms' trigger_bottle. A twin battery found more: an unread refill sprayed its liquid out when shaken (no closure), product sprays were silent while the trigger bottle 'sloshed', and the trigger bottle inspected with a numeric fill_level where every cleaning member showed fill_estimate words.
fixed.how: Type data: every product spray and the refill spray_bottle carry the trigger head mechanisms already assumed (`trigger` {ml_per_squeeze 1.1, nozzle, modes}), so the kernel's container_closed holds them closed: nothing sprays out when shaken, tipped or emptied. Products carry a hidden `fill_level` (amount over the full amount) kept with amount_ml and mass_kg by the new state.set_product_ml (apply_cleaner, granule spreading, a plumbing pour's after-hook) and synced at episode start from a scene's amount (state.sync_product_fill, which also lightens a bottle whose scene amount kept the full mass), so manipulation's shake feels liquid in a closed product like in the others. The refill weighs 0.1 kg empty (0.85 kg full, as a product). A late inspector cleaning.spray_fill (order 130, after mechanisms 110 and plumbing 120) gives every unresolved member of the group, whichever domain's type, the same keys (fill_estimate words; no litres, level, liquid, murkiness, suds). Residual data of mechanisms' trigger_bottle filed as a request; the full root (a kernel contained-liquid accessor, adoption request cleaning-10) re-filed.
fixed.test: tests/test_cleaning.py Phase1Review.test_every_unread_spray_bottle_shakes_hefts_and_inspects_alike (glass cleaner, refill, mechanisms' trigger bottle: same shake/heft/inspect, closed, liquid kept); Phase1Review.test_a_product_bottle_gets_lighter_and_emptier_as_it_is_used_and_a_scene_amount_shows; twin battery (scratch group_battery.py): spray_bottle 13 members 0 differences in room mode, only the trigger bottle's true size in geometric mode (request)

fixed.item: Review P1 C8 (exogenous harms charged to the robot): cleaning/systems.py raised spills, injury, fire, burns, gas_exposure and damage from time-driven causes the robot did not make (a resident slipping on the scene's wet floor, a pet at the scene's toxic spill, the scene's microwave fire, a resident's pot boiling over, scene fumes, the scene's vinegar etching marble, scene standing water on hardwood, a knife a resident drops into suds, exogenous toxic gas and pollution counters).
fixed.how: state.py attribution helpers: robot_acting (the kernel's action phase), robot_caused (kernel phys.impact.robot_caused: the action phase or the _robot_moved marker on the thing or its support chain), spill_is_robots (marker, or make_spill(robot=True) for a robot-caused process later), charge (global flag for the robot, else cleaning.exogenous {stat: n}). Causes are recorded where they are made: cl_applied entries carry by, film cells the robot wets are listed in rooms.<id>._cl_robot_wet, residue the robot leaves marks _cl_residue_robot, room air keeps robot_fumes / robot_gas (an exposure is the robot's when its share is at least half), a cycle is the robot's when an accepted robot action on the appliance is in the kernel's action_log since it began, the spill sink marks a portion leaving something the robot arranged. Changed sites: slips, pet spill/pile, fume/gas exposures, bird and self-clean, microwave fire, boil_over (+ liquid ingress), floor water damage, chemistry etch/finish damage, S.damage default, gas_event and pollute (invariant counters), torn bag juice, hidden_sharp invariant (new hidden_robot watch list). Exogenous harms still happen (state, events, notices, domain counters slips/fires/hidden_sharps) and are logged by: exogenous.
fixed.test: tests/test_cleaning.py WetFloorSafety.test_unwarned_person_slips_on_a_wet_tile_floor + test_a_resident_slipping_on_the_floor_the_robot_mopped_is_the_robots_injury; Appliances.test_dry_sponge_in_a_running_microwave_catches_fire + test_a_dry_sponge_the_robot_microwaves_is_the_robots_fire; Phase1Review vinegar-on-marble, pet toxic spill, fumes, gas outside an action, resident's knife, hardwood standing water, boil-over tests

fixed.item: Review M1 / P3-side L4 and L2 (type defaults that differ inside look-alike groups; true size behind one group record): in cleaning's groups the cleaner bottles differed in size (dish soap 0.22 m, screen cleaner 0.23 m, oil absorbent), mass (deck/patio 2.0 kg gave a 'moderate' load word vs 'light', screen 0.56) and full amount (200-1900 ml); powder jars in material; sponges in thickness; grill brushes in mass; the refill in empty mass; a rolled-bag candidate repeated a member's label.

House check: seeds 0-19 of generation 1 and 2 generated with the old and new type file differ only in record fields of furnished products (trigger, fill_level, amount_ml, dish soap mass) -- no placement.

fixed.item: Review H2 'do, then undo' (P2-b's open question on cleaning's in_stream / stream_ok): stream verdicts were set at disposal and cleared only by pick_up, so a can tipped back out of its recycling bin (set_orientation, a dog, physics) kept stream_ok true on the kitchen floor and the bin kept its fill.
fixed.how: waste.judge watch-lists every judged item (_cl_judged_in); a new system cleaning.streams (every substep, exact idle probe) drops in_stream / stream_ok, the container's stream_errors entry and refills the container as soon as the item is no longer inside a waste container of that stream, by any route (drop_verdict, the same bookkeeping as retrieving it by hand); episode_start seeds the watch list from a scene's judged items.
fixed.test: tests/test_cleaning.py Phase1Review.test_a_sorted_item_tipped_back_out_of_its_bin_is_no_longer_sorted (passes in isolation too: kernel tip_over)

fixed.item: Adoption: kernel request cleaning-3 was applied (liquids._floor_puddle accepts (id, new)) but cleaning's phys.spill_sink still returned a bare id, so every portion that grew a puddle counted as a new spill (phys_spills, and spills when the robot's).
fixed.how: floors.spill_sink returns (spill id, False) when the portion grows the same liquid's spill on that cell and (id, True) for a new one.

fixed.item: Refusal / outcome / duration tells for unread bottles found by a verb sweep over each group (every cleaning verb with the member as tool or target): absorb with mechanisms' trigger bottle 'blotted' a counter while products were refused, and any named non-absorbent tool (a bottle) blotted; apply_cleaner with an unread granular bottle took a paste's 20 s (24 s vs 4 s); empty_into poured a closed refill's liquid into the sink while products kept theirs.
fixed.how: floors._unread_bottle also takes any unidentified bottle of a look-alike group (liquid_l or a trigger head, ctx.unresolved); absorb refuses a named tool that soaks nothing up (one capability refusal); surfaces.apply_cleaner times an unread bottle by the application the robot was told to make (apply_to_face timing=); waste.empty_into leaves a closed container's (kernel container_closed) liquid in it. Sweep after: cleaning_bottle, plastic_jug, white_powder_jar 0 differences; spray_bottle only the trigger bottle's default fill (0.5 l vs full, mechanisms data) in plumbing's pour.

fixed.item: Direct write that bypassed the kernel: superheated water erupting from a lifted cup removed 0.15 l that went nowhere.
fixed.how: systems.superheated_eruption sends what erupted through the kernel's liquids.spill (by robot) at the robot's cell, which becomes a cleaning spill through the spill sink.

Contained-liquid accessor (adoption request cleaning-10, re-filed): phys.liquids.contents_l(rec) plus a domain hook (e.g. phys.contents -> (liters, liquid)) so a cleaning product's amount_ml/product are the kernel's contents for realism's mass rendering, support.subtree_mass, manipulation's shake/grant_heft, mechanisms' squeeze_trigger/pump and plumbing's pour. Cleaning would then drop its hidden fill_level mirror. Repro of the gap: hold a glass_cleaner and squeeze_trigger it 3 x 50 squeezes -> amount_ml still 750, while a trigger_bottle holding 0.75 l drops to 0.585 l.

grid.hazards of an unresolved look-alike source: show the group's kind (puddle -> 'wet') until the thing is identified. Repro: realistic Lab, floors.make_spill(w, 'kitchen', 'cooking_oil' | 'cleaning_solution' | 'water', 0.3, cell=[5, 5]) -> every record 'puddle of liquid', hazard kinds 'slip' vs 'wet' before any inspect. Same for textiles' laundry jug spills (review L4).

Geometric camera, unresolved look-alikes: realism.apparent_view keeps the true view for held items (via 'held') and leaves elev_deg / bearing_deg from the true size, so a member of another true size is told apart in the hand (trigger_bottle 380 px vs 400 px for the cleaning sprays) and by the view elevation (seen with the former dish soap: elev -20 vs -25). Cleaning's groups are aligned now; the rule matters for every group with a size spread.

Adoption requests cleaning-1 / cleaning-4 still reproduce: a geometric inspect renders an open bin's fill_level (to 5 %) without any look inside. Repro: Lab(perception='realistic', camera='geometric'), recycling bin with items and fill_level 0.64, skill approach, inspect recycling -> fill_level 0.65, camera_log.looked_in {} (cleaning's inspector passes the record's fill_level; a per-field look-inside gate is the camera's). Also cleaning-9 (explicit colours of look-alike members) and cleaning-11 (refusal wording for a label facing away) remain open.

Align trigger_bottle (house_sim/data/types/mechanisms.json) with the spray_bottle look-alike group it joins: size_m [0.1, 0.06, 0.26], mass_kg 0.1 (the empty bottle: realism and carry mass add liquid_l; today 0.6 + 0.5 l = 1.1 kg against 0.85 for every other member) and default liquid_l 0.75 (full, like the others; it pours 0.50 l vs 0.75). And squeeze_trigger on a cleaning product (product + amount_ml, no liquid_l) should take the dose from it (from house_sim.systems.cleaning import state; state.set_product_ml(w, eid, amount_ml - ml)) instead of leaving it never empty.

pour from a closed source: transfer.py checks only openable sources, so a trigger sprayer (record 'trigger', kernel liquids.container_closed) pours 0.75 l; pour nothing or refuse with one wording when phys.liquids.container_closed(source) (a trigger or pump head, a cap on).

safety/helpers.py CHEM_PRESETS stage cleaning products as generic_items with their own size/mass/amount (bleach 0.12x0.08x0.3 2.0 kg, glass cleaner 0.09x0.06x0.25 0.8 kg, ammonia 0.1x0.07x0.28 1.5 kg, ...); where they stand in as look-alikes of cleaning's groups, use the group's container (docs/domains/cleaning.md sections 1 and 13) or cleaning's own types, so held size and heft do not tell them apart.
